title: Mitigating Gender Bias in Contextual Word Embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: For contextual embeddings, the paper measures bias by evaluating predicted probabilities of masked gendered pronouns and occupations using Winogender schemas, calculating stereotype scores based on pseudo log-likelihood using the WinoBias dataset, and applying the Sentence Embedding Association Test (SEAT). For static embeddings, bias is evaluated through gender-profession clustering accuracy, SemBias word analogy accuracy for definitional and stereotypical pairs, and by analyzing direct and proximity bias of neighboring words.
